channel.description: Latest articles from Business Today India (businesstoday.in)

item.title: San Francisco-based founder claims Anthropic’s Claude update crushed her startup
item.description: Once scaling as a fast-growing venture with hundreds of clients, experienced a steep drop to 20% within hours after Anthropic’s Claude update.

item.title: Nvidia posts record $216 billion annual revenue as AI chip demand surges
item.description: For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, Nvidia forecast revenue of $78.0 billion, plus or minus 2%, ahead of analysts’ expectations. However, the company said it was not assuming any data centre compute revenue from China in its outlook.

item.title: 'India-Pakistan thing is going to go': R Madhavan spills the beans on 'Dhurandhar 2' ahead of box office clash with 'Toxic'
item.description: He suggested that the classic "border war" template has been exhausted.

item.title: Explained: All about ED's chargesheet against Ranya Rao, gang that smuggled 127 kg gold to India, and more
item.description: The "organised and structured" mechanism involved a network of handlers and jewellers who liquidated the gold in the domestic market, generating massive cash reserves.

item.title: Polycab India, KEI Industries, Hitachi Energy: Cable & wire stocks at 52-week highs; what investors should do?
item.description: According to Rajani, after enduring a running correction in January 2026, the stock has resumed its primary uptrend and is on the verge of printing new all-time highs above the 5,040 mark.

item.title: Centre apologises in SC over Class 8 NCERT judiciary chapter; CJI says 'want to know who is behind'
item.description: Appearing before the court, the government said those responsible for the chapter would face consequences and would be permanently excluded from any future work with the Education Ministry

item.title: Yes Bank under RBI lens after data leak on BookMyForex card
item.description: Yes Bank said its Multi-Currency Prepaid Forex Card, issued in partnership with BookMyForex, observed an unusual increase in transaction declines by its fraud monitoring system

item.title: Treat governance, disclosures as reputational assets: CEA V Anantha Nageswaran to capital market participants
item.description: A financial system that combines technological sophistication with institutional improvements can act as a stabilising force in an increasingly uncertain global environment, the CEA said.
